messages:
maria: Seeing a spike in interactive sparkline LCP across EU after yesterday's widget split rollout. Charts hang ~1.2s extra and we're getting a flood of kvcache misses. cc @devon @olga :eyes:

devon: I see the same in routing logs — a lot of requests are falling back to the cold pool. Looks like affinity changed when we introduced splitpoints.

olga: Telemetry shows main-thread parse time up ~35% for the saffron widget and the module size for `widget-saffron` increased ~78KB. Traces: https://telemetry.internal/r/abc123 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ci-bot: Deployed saffron-split canary to EU/hosted at 2025-11-12T03:22Z by @tim (roll id r-3412) :rocket:

tim: I rolled the canary. It increased async chunk count but I didn't expect KV-prefetch keying to change. What routing policy was active for these requests?

devon: Routing policy `prefer-local` — with splitpoints the split route header got `x-console-route: sparklines` and those hit a node-group that didn't get the prewarm job. So we fell back to cold workers and saw bigger parse times and more chunk loads.

maria: Snippet from the client console: ```Error: Chunk load timeout at widget-saffron.js:1``` Also logs show repeated lines like `kvcache: miss key=sparkline/v2/user/UID123` and `chunk-fetch: retry`.

olga: We're also seeing an increased telemetry-sampler drop rate for EU; sampled traces include a heavy `Intl` polyfill parse step. My hypothesis: bundle ordering shifted and the polyfill moved into critical path for some routes.

alice: Can someone bisect which change added that import? Quick `git blame` on the built artifact points to commit `5f3a2e` — it added `saffron/intl` import in `saffron-widget/index.tsx`.

tim: We should revert the canary in EU or flip the feature flag for the split. I can cut a rollback if folks agree, or I can flip `feature.saffron.split` to false.

devon: +1 flip the flag first for immediate relief. I'll also put up a small routing fix so that requests with `x-console-route` route to warmed groups or fallback to global pool instead of cold group.

infra-bot: ALERT: EU-frontend nodes CPU spike to 48% at 03:28Z; 3 nodes restarted. Auto-restart engaged. See: https://infra.alerts/evt/4492

maria: Flipped the flag at 03:40Z — EU canary reverted. Initial local checks look better (interactive traces dropped ~900ms). Dashboards will show stable numbers in ~5m. :thumbsup:

olga: Action items: add a small telemetry probe that surfaces `kvcache` hit ratio by route and `module-parse` time per chunk, and include module size diffs in artifact metadata. Also add a prefetch/warmup job for route node-groups before canary ramp.

tim: I'll open a PR (eng-platform/#4392) with the flag flip + warmup job + a short rollback playbook. Assigning @devon to the routing affinity change. :memo:

devon: Will follow up with a tiny routing patch and canary it to a single EU shard once warmup is in place. Thanks for quick triage, everyone. :raised_hands:
